corrective_controls: preflight protocol hash verification before holdout data access
exact D4 model and metadata SHA-256 verification before deserialization
hard refusal to rerun holdout after h3_confirmatory_result is present

findings.correction: All protocol/input/model-byte gates now run before joblib deserialization and before load_selection_instances can read holdout rows. A sealed H3 entry causes immediate refusal of any later holdout execution.
findings.finding: The frozen protocol identity gate ran after analyze_h3. Two aborted executions therefore completed H3 computation before failing identity validation; the third execution produced the sealed result.
findings.observed_boundary: The two aborted executions stopped before result-file write, stdout result publication, or ledger mutation, as documented in the contemporaneous audit note.

findings.correction: Preflight now verifies exact D4 model and metadata SHA-256 values before joblib.load, then cross-checks the deserialized object's protocol/cv/pool identity.
findings.finding: The D7 implementation checked model metadata cv_spec_hash but did not require the model and metadata file SHA-256 values to equal the exact D4 ledger index=3 bytes before deserialization.
findings.observed_boundary: The model_file_sha256 and metadata_file_sha256 recorded in the sealed H3 result are byte-identical to the values pinned at D4 ledger index=3.

findings.correction: statistics.median now defines median_D for any future study/run.
findings.finding: median_D used the upper middle order statistic for even n instead of the conventional average of the two central values.
findings.impact_on_primary_inference: unchanged: H3's preregistered test statistic is mean_D, not median_D
findings.why_not_recomputed: Per-field D values were not sealed in h3_result.json. The project will not reconsume holdout outcomes merely to repair a secondary descriptive statistic.

primary_inference.holm_family_conclusion: H1 supported; H2 supported; H3 not supported

status.study_001_primary_conclusion: H1 supported; H2 supported; H3 not supported
